# `nlink-lab link`

Change a running lab's links in place, like `node`: edited, validated,
reconciled with `apply`.

```bash
sudo nlink-lab link add r1:eth3 r2:eth3 10.9.0.1/30 10.9.0.2/30
sudo nlink-lab link set r1:eth3 --mtu 1280            # both ends, live
sudo nlink-lab link set r1:eth3 --qdisc fq_codel,target=5ms,ecn
sudo nlink-lab link set r1:eth3 --clear-qdisc
sudo nlink-lab link rm r1:eth3                        # both ends go
```

Impairments (delay, loss, rate, partitions) are [`impair`](impair.md)'s.

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Add, remove or change a link of a running lab (MTU, qdisc)

Usage: nlink-lab link <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add   Add a veth link: `link add r1:eth2 r2:eth2 10.9.0.1/30 10.9.0.2/30` (the addresses are optional, both or none)
  rm    Remove the links that have these endpoints (both ends go)
  set   Change a link: its MTU (both ends, live) or an endpoint's root qdisc (impairments are `impair`'s)
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```
